Name: Chloe of Corinth
Role: Head of a household in Corinth
Summary: Chloe is named in 1 Corinthians 1:11 as head of a household whose members reported the contentions dividing the Corinthian church.
KeyStory: Chloe is named in 1 Corinthians 1:11 as head of a household whose members reported the contentions dividing the Corinthian church.
LifeLesson: Honest reports about division are the first step toward healing it.
